verses.text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

segments.text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent
thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

verses.text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

segments.text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

verses.text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

segments.text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

verses.text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

segments.text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

verses.text: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

segments.text: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

verses.text: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:

segments.text: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all

verses.text: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

segments.text: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

notes: 8.7 All…: Heb. Flocks and oxen all of them

verses.text: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

segments.text: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea,
passeth through the paths of the seas.

verses.text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

segments.text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent
thy name in all the earth!

headings.text: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David.
